title: Ability fields
description: Fields shared by every ability class.

ability_id.description: A stable identifier for this ability within its card.

flavor_word.description: An optional flavor-word label. It has no rules meaning and is not an enumerated vocabulary (CR 207.2d).

keyword_ability_id.description: The ID of a CR 702 keyword ability that this ability expresses. This does not change the ability class.

keyword_instance_id.description: Groups class abilities represented by the same keyword-ability instance. Used only when one keyword represents multiple abilities.

keyword_amount.description: The number the keyword ability takes, when it holds one: the 1 of Fabricate 1, the {2} of Ward {2} (CR 702).
